description: An elderly man in a canvas apron and dark waistcoat, sleeves rolled, lifts the top half of a two-part metal mould on a workbench, revealing a glossy dark chocolate egg with a textured shell. Steam rises from the mould. Several finished chocolate eggs and empty moulds sit on the wooden bench, with a clamp and tools at left, a brick wall behind, and a stoneware jug of yellow daffodils at lower right. The painting is warm and dark, in an oil-painting style, and fills the frame with no visible border or text.
